realm.name: MPS_Staff
realm.description: Composite convenience role - any MPSGEI internal staff persona. Use for coarse staff-console route guards.

realm.name: NIS_Officer
realm.description: NIS staff member with access to citizen contribution and benefits records within the National Insurance Scheme portal.

realm.name: Administrator
realm.description: Full administrative access across the Citizen Portal and connected services — user management, role assignment, and system configuration.

realm.name: MPS_CPO
realm.description: MPS Chief Personnel Officer - Ready-for-Assignment marking, officer assignment/reassignment, MINUTE recording, summary-sheet compilation, duplicate-flag resolution, dispatch permission.

realm.name: MPS_Minister
realm.description: MPS Honorable Minister - aggregate summary-sheet review of new-employment and changed-condition renewal candidates; salary-variance view.

realm.name: MPS_PS
realm.description: MPS Permanent Secretary - reviews/reassigns incoming requests to CPO, sole final approver and signatory per-request and on the Minister summary sheet.

realm.name: GRA_Officer
realm.description: GRA staff member with access to citizen tax records, TIN data, and filings within the Guyana Revenue Authority portal

realm.name: GPL_Officer
realm.description: GPL staff member with access to citizen billing and account records within the Guyana Power and Light portal

realm.name: MPS_IT_Admin
realm.description: MPS IT Administrator - role/permission configuration, IAP console registration, reference-data administration, PS/CPO availability marking.

realm.name: Citizen
realm.description: Standard authenticated citizen with access to their own personal records across connected government services (NIS, GRA, GPL, Passport)

realm.name: MPS_Agency_Originator
realm.description: MPS Workforce Portal - designated agency originator (PS / REO / Head of Department). Submits new employment, renewal, and lifecycle-change requests for their own agency only.

realm.name: MPS_Conf_Secretary
realm.description: MPS PS Confidential Secretary - manual-signature loop mechanics, restricted on-behalf-of intake (source channel recorded), dispatch permission.

realm.name: MPS_HR_Officer
realm.description: MPS HR / Personnel Officer - per-line review, clarification/rework loop, minute & memorandum drafting, reference-data maintenance. No visibility of requests prior to CPO assignment.

realm.name: MPS_Data_Clerk
realm.description: MPS Data Entry Clerk - scans and uploads signed memoranda for requests in Signed-Pending-Scan status only; no review or approval permissions.

realm.name: MPS_Agency_Minister
realm.description: MPS Workforce Portal - Minister of the originating agency/ministry/region. Pre-MPS review of the agency's own requests: records Acknowledged or an Objection with mandatory comment; agency-scoped by /MPS-Agencies group like the originator. NOT MPS staff.

clients.name: mps-agency-portal
clients.description: MPS Workforce Portal - Agency self-service SPA (designated originators). OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE.

clients.name: mps-provisioning-service
clients.description: Confidential service-account client used by the MuleSoft System API for MPS user/group provisioning via the Keycloak Admin API. Regenerate the secret after import.

clients.name: mps-staff-console
clients.description: MPS Workforce Portal - Staff console SPA (PS, CPO, Officers, Confidential Secretary, Clerk, Minister, IT Admin). OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE. Bind a dedicated browser flow with required OTP before go-live.
